_comment: HAND-KEPT. Service areas listed on got-moles.com/service-areas that the visit-derived lookup cannot know about yet. Read by build-zip-day-lookup.mjs and build-address-day-lookup.mjs. newZips = we serve it but no truck has a regular day there, so the pages say YES and book without promising a day; a zip drops off this list on its own once real visits give it a day. aliases = neighborhood or town names that sit inside zips we already run, so a city search finds them.
